description: This file defines the FileStream::Context class, which manages asynchronous file I/O operations with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems. It includes methods for opening, closing, reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving file info, with internal handling for asynchronous operations and platform-dependent code separation.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Manages platform-specific asynchronous file I/O operations, including opening, closing, reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving file info, with support for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from the file into the provided buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from the buffer to the file.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags asynchronously.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset in the file asynchronously.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data to the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Orphan
methods.description: Destroys the context, deferring deletion if async operations are in progress.
